name: Claude
tagline: Bring your drafts, documents, and code into a conversation without opening another browser tab.
description:
Claude Desktop is Anthropic’s desktop client for working with Claude through conversations, documents, images, code, and connected tools. On macOS, its quick-entry workflow can bring the assistant forward from a shortcut and share selected application or screen context when you choose to do so.

The app is useful when an AI task belongs beside the work rather than in a separate browser tab. You can ask for help with a draft, inspect an error message, summarize material, reason through a plan, or send a focused piece of on-screen context into a conversation for review.

## Features

- Open a quick-entry prompt on macOS to start a focused chat without leaving the active application.
- Attach documents, images, and supported context for analysis, writing, reasoning, and coding help.
- Share an application window or selected screen context for tasks such as debugging, summarization, and review when the relevant desktop permissions are enabled.
- Organize longer work in Claude’s current projects and conversation tools according to the account features available to you.
- Use desktop links and supported local-tool connections to open a chat, Cowork session, or Code session from another app or script.
- Review every AI result before acting on it, especially when it involves confidential content, factual claims, code changes, or external actions.

## Where it fits

Claude Desktop suits people who want a capable writing, analysis, and coding assistant available from the Mac rather than only in a browser. Quick entry is particularly useful for small questions that arise while working in another app.

It is not a replacement for verification, editing, or human accountability. The most advanced workflows may require a specific plan, supported permissions, or separate tools such as Claude Code.

## Privacy and requirements

Claude requires an Anthropic account and an internet connection for its model-backed features. Text, files, screen context, and connected-service data are processed under the policy for the selected consumer, Team, or Enterprise account. The desktop app should receive only the screen, file, microphone, or Accessibility permissions needed for the chosen workflow, especially on a work Mac.

## Pricing

Claude includes a free tier. Pro $20/month.
